t: Titan medium version 1/3 sander backing pad restores worn hook and loop surfaces to improve disc retention and sanding efficiency. The universal-fit replacement pad is ideal for carpenters and decorators undertaking heavy-duty sanding. Manufactured with durable ethylene-vinyl acetate foam and polypropylene, the medium-density pad offers excellent flexibility. Easy to install by sanding down old hooks, cleaning, and applying the new pad. Extends tool life, ensuring a fast and reliable finish.
b: Simple Installation Restores Sanding Performance Quickly
Foam Construction Offers Medium Support & Flexibility
Pad Density Delivers Consistent & Flat Finishes
Backing Fastener Secures Pad to the Sander
Replacement Pad Extends the Utility of Older Tools
